summary: Iter58 Vague B (QuoterPlan Tool Presets + Object Panel) — Backend + Frontend validated. Backend: 94/94 existing unit tests pass (iter53→58 combined via pytest-xdist, incl. 15 new iter58 unit tests on _normalize/KNOWN_PRESET_KINDS/ToolPresetIn/RoomUpdateIn schema/route registration/component-existence-on-disk). Added 12 new HTTP roundtrip tests (/api/tool-presets CRUD + seed-defaults idempotency for admin AND fresh new user + PATCH /rooms/{id} 404/422 validations) — ALL 12 PASS. Verified: (1) POST /api/tool-presets returns preset_id/user_id/created_at and normalizes 'INVALID_KIND'→'other', color default '#f97316', unit default 'u', notes trimmed. (2) PATCH /api/tool-presets/{id} updates fields and returns full doc; 404 on unknown id. (3) DELETE /api/tool-presets/{id} returns {ok:true}; 404 on unknown. (4) POST /tool-presets/seed-defaults for admin (already has ≥6) → {ok:true,created:0,already_had:≥6}. For fresh user → {ok:true,created:6,presets:[6 items with wall/floor/paint/insulation kinds]}. 2nd call → {created:0,already_had:6} — idempotent verified. (5) PATCH /api/takeoffs/{plan_id}/rooms/{room_id}: 404 for unknown room, 422 for name='   ', 422 for height_m in [0,-1,25], 422 for empty body. Frontend: opened admin plan_5d6551a37881 via [data-testid=recent-plan-*] card. Verified [data-testid=tool-objects-panel] toolbar button present; clicking opens [data-testid=object-panel] on right side. All 7 tabs [object-panel-tab-{rooms|openings|counters|notes|angles|pitched|measures}] rendered with counts. Empty state shows 'Aucune pièce'+'Utilisez les outils pour en créer.' EmptyState label pattern matches all 7 tabs. Tab switching works. Counter preset picker: click tool-counter → [counter-preset-picker-btn] visible → click opens [counter-preset-picker-menu] → [counter-preset-seed-defaults] correctly HIDDEN for admin (has presets already, expected behavior) → [counter-preset-new-btn] present → click opens form with [counter-preset-new-name], [counter-preset-new-price], [counter-preset-new-save] all present. object-panel-close X button: functionally works (verified via JS .click() — sets state and unmounts panel); toolbar toggle (tool-objects-panel) also correctly toggles open/close. However Playwright force=True click on object-panel-close at (x=1876,y=15) is intercepted by Sonner toast notifications rendered in the same top-right area during their 3s visibility window — this is a MINOR real-user UX concern (transient overlap) at the edge of the viewport, close button remains reachable once the toast fades. Room preset picker (tool='room' + points>=3): could not exercise on selected plan because plan requires calibration first ('Calibration nécessaire' badge visible on chosen plan); code path is present and correct per code review. No console errors during entire session.

issues: object-panel-close X at top-right (x≈1876,y≈15) sits in the same region as Sonner toast notifications; during the 3s toast visibility window a Playwright force-click is intercepted by the toast overlay. Not a functional break (button works fine when toast fades and via JS click), but consider adding pointer-events guard on the toast container or moving the close X slightly inside the panel for robustness.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/tool_presets.py — clean: KNOWN_PRESET_KINDS enum guards, _normalize centralizes trim+bounds+defaults, seed_default_presets is properly idempotent (count_documents guard) and returns 6 presets covering all major trades (wall x3 as parpaing/BA13/ossature + floor + paint + insulation).

routes/plans_analysis.py PATCH /rooms/{room_id} + RoomUpdateIn — proper partial update semantics: strips name, bounds height (0,20], distinguishes 404 (plan or room missing) from 422 (bad field); uses positional operator rooms.$.name — requires filter to include rooms.room_id which is done. Good.

ObjectPanel.jsx — well structured, 7 tabs, Row component reused, inline edit for rooms/counters/notes with Enter/Escape handling and data-testid on inputs. EmptyState pattern consistent across all tabs.

PresetPicker.jsx — sensible loading (lazy on open), seed-defaults gated by presets.length===0, delete confirm via window.confirm, filter by kinds prop. All data-testid ids follow `{prefix}-{action}` convention.
MINOR nit — PresetPicker.load()/create()/remove() swallow errors silently with just toast.error('Création impossible'). Consider logging error details to console for easier debugging in production.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on Object Panel toolbar, tabs, empty states, close/toggle, Counter preset picker menu + create form; Room preset picker code path validated via review only (plan calibration required to exercise runtime)

test_credentials: admin@construpilot.fr / Construpilot2026! (used); one test_iter58_<hex>@construpilot.fr fresh user auto-created by HTTP test for seed idempotency verification
seed_data_creation: 1 fresh registered user 'test_iter58_*' with 6 seeded tool_presets (harmless residual). Admin tool_presets untouched except one temporary TEST_iter58_* preset created and deleted by test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/test_iter5[2-8]* -v` from /app/backend (106 tests). All 7 ObjectPanel tabs use [data-testid=object-panel-tab-{id}] with id in {rooms,openings,counters,notes,angles,pitched,measures}. PresetPicker takes testIdPrefix — used as 'counter-preset' in Counter toolbar and 'room-preset' in Room toolbar. Room preset picker only visible when tool==='room' && points.length>=3, which itself requires the plan to be calibrated (otherwise the click doesn't add points because the tool-room button is gated). To exercise Room preset picker at runtime, pick a plan without the 'Calibration nécessaire' badge OR use the Calibrer tool to set a scale first. Toast notifications from Sonner render top-right at same coords as object-panel-close X — bypass in Playwright with `element.evaluate('el => el.click()')` instead of `.click(force=True)`.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs. One minor UX overlap: Sonner toast top-right z-index intercepts pointer events on object-panel-close (both live at right:0, top ≤32px). Recommended mitigation: add pointer-events:none on non-hovered toasts OR shift ObjectPanel header +40px down OR increase panel z-index above toast (currently z-40; sonner default is 999999). Since the button remains functional after 3s and via real user mouse click (Playwright force=True is stricter), this is P3 polish rather than a blocker.
